name: Blood Harvester raises party/raid critical strike chance
contract: Blood Harvester 300889 promises party/raid members gain 3% critical strike chance. Its single effect is native SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with EffectApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290) and EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3. Both the area-aura target and the crit-percent aura are core-handled with no CoA registration required; #3905's zero-hits-in-source is expected here.

steps.label: Blood Harvester spread to the party member
